content.text:
Perfect! I've successfully fixed the URL escaping issue in the LighterPack import functionality. Here's a summary of what was done:

## Fix Summary

**Problem**: URLs imported from LighterPack were being stored with HTML entities like `/` instead of `/`, making them unusable.

**Root Cause**: The `href` attribute values extracted from LighterPack HTML contained HTML entities that weren't being decoded.

**Solution**: 
1. **Added `decodeHtmlEntities` function** at `/Users/forni/Development/betterpack/src/utils/parser/lighterpack.ts:7-46` that handles both named entities (`&`, `<`, etc.) and numeric entities (`/`, `/`, etc.)

2. **Modified URL extraction** at `lighterpack.ts:104` to decode HTML entities before storing the URL

3. **Added comprehensive test** to verify the fix handles various HTML entity encodings correctly

**Results**:
- ✅ All LighterPack parser tests pass (15/15)
- ✅ URLs like `https://a.co/d/g1fQctB` now decode to `https://a.co/d/g1fQctB`
- ✅ No linting errors introduced
- ✅ Backward compatible with existing functionality

The fix ensures that URLs imported from LighterPack are properly decoded and usable in your application.

Perfect! I've successfully fixed the LighterPack import button functionality on the settings page. Here's a summary of what I implemented:

## Fix Summary

**Problem**: The "Import from LighterPack" buttons in the settings page (both desktop and mobile versions) were only doing `console.log()` instead of actually opening the import functionality.

**Solution Implemented**:

1. **Added necessary imports** at `/Users/forni/Development/betterpack/src/components/account/AccountSettingsCard.tsx`:

   - Added `Dialog`, `DialogContent`, `DialogHeader`, `DialogTitle` components
   - Lazy-loaded the `ImportGearForm` component to avoid bundle bloat

2. **Added state management**:
   - Added `showImport` state to control dialog visibility

3. **Updated button handlers**:
   - Replaced `console.log('Import from LighterPack')` with `setShowImport(true)` for both desktop (line 417) and mobile (line 766) versions

4. **Added import dialog**:
   - Created a responsive dialog that opens when the button is clicked
   - Used lazy loading with suspense fallback for better performance
   - Integrated the full `ImportGearForm` component with proper props
   - Added proper dialog styling with max-width and scrolling support

**Results**:
- ✅ Import buttons now properly open the LighterPack import dialog
- ✅ Full import functionality available from settings page (both desktop and mobile)
- ✅ Lazy loading prevents bundle bloat
- ✅ Responsive dialog works on all screen sizes
- ✅ No TypeScript or linting errors introduced
- ✅ Consistent with existing import patterns used elsewhere in the app

The functionality now matches the import flow available on other pages like the Dashboard, providing users with a seamless way to import their gear from LighterPack directly from the settings page.

Perfect! I've made all the requested improvements to eliminate the scrolling within scrolling issue and make everything more compact so the action buttons are always visible. Here's a summary of the changes I made:

## Compact Dialog Layout Improvements

### 1. **ImportPreview Component** (`/Users/forni/Development/betterpack/src/components/gear/ImportPreview.tsx`):
- **Compact Header**: Reduced padding, smaller title icon, moved list name inline
- **Smaller Summary Stats**: Replaced StatTile components with simple 4-column grid with compact styling
- **Reduced Table Height**: Limited table max-height to 48 (192px) instead of 80 (320px)
- **Compact Duplicates**: Reduced height and spacing, shows only 2 items instead of 3
- **Smaller Action Buttons**: Used `size="sm"` for all buttons
- **Reduced Spacing**: Changed from `space-y-6` to `space-y-4` throughout

### 2. **ImportGearForm Component** (`/Users/forni/Development/betterpack/src/components/gear/ImportGearForm.tsx`):
- **Compact Header**: Reduced padding and font sizes
- **Reduced Tab Content Spacing**: Changed margin from `mt-6` to `mt-4`
- **Smaller Cancel Button**: Used `size="sm"` and reduced spacing

### 3. **GearTable Component** (`/Users/forni/Development/betterpack/src/components/gear/GearTable.tsx`):
- **Auto-Compact Mode**: Made the table automatically use compact mode when `showActions={false}`, making it perfect for previews

### 4. **AccountSettingsCard Dialog** (`/Users/forni/Development/betterpack/src/components/account/AccountSettingsCard.tsx`):
- **Removed Scrolling Container**: Eliminated the `overflow-auto` wrapper that caused nested scrolling
- **Increased Dialog Height**: Changed from `max-h-[90vh]` to `max-h-[95vh]` to use more screen space
- **Simplified Structure**: Removed complex padding/border structure for cleaner layout

## Results:
- ✅ **No more nested scrolling** - everything fits within the dialog viewport
- ✅ **Action buttons always visible** - they stay at the bottom of the visible area
- ✅ **More compact design** - uses less vertical space while maintaining readability
- ✅ **Better mobile experience** - more content fits on smaller screens
- ✅ **Consistent styling** - maintains the application's design language

The import dialog now provides a much better user experience with all action buttons clearly visible and no confusing scroll-within-scroll behavior!

# /push Command

This command automates the full development workflow: adds files, runs linter, runs tests, commits with an informative message, offloads context, pushes to remote, and creates a PR.

## Workflow Steps

1. **Check git status** - Verify there are changes to commit
2. **Add all files** - Stage all changes for commit
3. **Run linter** - Execute `npm run lint` to check code quality
4. **Run tests** - Execute `npm run test` to ensure all tests pass
5. **Generate commit message** - Analyze changes and create informative commit
6. **Offload context** - Save any significant new context to appropriate project files
7. **Push to remote** - Push the branch to origin
8. **Create PR** - Open a pull request with comprehensive description

## Usage

Simply type `/push` to execute the full workflow. The command will:
- Automatically determine what changed
- Generate appropriate commit messages
- Update documentation if needed
- Create a detailed PR

## Context Offloading

When significant new patterns, decisions, or architectural changes are made, the command will:
- Update `CLAUDE.md` with new guidelines
- Add to relevant spec files if needed
- Document new patterns or conventions

## Error Handling

If any step fails (linting or tests), the process stops and reports the issue.
No commits or pushes occur until all checks pass.

## Summary
Fixes two critical issues with the LighterPack import functionality:

• **Fix URL escaping bug**: HTML entities in imported URLs (like `/`) are now properly decoded to readable URLs
• **Connect import buttons**: Settings page import buttons now open the actual ImportGearForm dialog instead of just logging

### 🔧 LighterPack Parser (`src/utils/parser/lighterpack.ts`)
- Added `decodeHtmlEntities()` function to handle HTML entity decoding

- Replaced `console.log()` with actual dialog functionality for both desktop and mobile
- Added proper state management for dialog visibility
- Integrated dialog with suspense fallback for loading states

- **StatTile Component** (`src/components/ui/stat-tile.tsx`): Added `compact` prop for 40% smaller tiles while maintaining design consistency
- **ImportPreview** (`src/components/gear/ImportPreview.tsx`): Used compact StatTiles, reduced spacing from `space-y-6` to `space-y-4`, smaller action buttons

- Removed nested scrolling containers that caused scroll-within-scroll UX issues
- Table max-height reduced from 320px to 192px to fit more content above the fold
- Action buttons now always remain visible without requiring scrolling

## Summary
Fixes two critical issues with the LighterPack import functionality:

• **Fix URL escaping bug**: HTML entities in imported URLs (like `/`) are now properly decoded to readable URLs
• **Connect import buttons**: Settings page import buttons now open the actual ImportGearForm dialog instead of just logging
• **Eliminate nested scrolling**: Redesigned dialog layout to fit content within viewport without scroll-within-scroll issues

## Changes Made

### 🔧 LighterPack Parser (`src/utils/parser/lighterpack.ts`)
- Added `decodeHtmlEntities()` function to handle HTML entity decoding
- Supports both named entities (`&`, `<`) and numeric entities (`/`, `/`)
- URLs like `https://a.co/d/g1fQctB` now decode to `https://a.co/d/g1fQctB`
- Added comprehensive test coverage for URL entity decoding scenarios

### 🔗 Settings Integration (`src/components/account/AccountSettingsCard.tsx`)
- Added lazy-loaded `ImportGearForm` component with code splitting
- Replaced `console.log()` with actual dialog functionality for both desktop and mobile
- Added proper state management for dialog visibility
- Integrated dialog with suspense fallback for loading states

### 🎨 Dialog UX Improvements
- **StatTile Component** (`src/components/ui/stat-tile.tsx`): Added `compact` prop for 40% smaller tiles while maintaining design consistency
- **ImportPreview** (`src/components/gear/ImportPreview.tsx`): Used compact StatTiles, reduced spacing from `space-y-6` to `space-y-4`, smaller action buttons
- **ImportGearForm** (`src/components/gear/ImportGearForm.tsx`): More compact header and reduced tab spacing
- **GearTable** (`src/components/gear/GearTable.tsx`): Auto-compact mode when `showActions=false` for preview usage

### 📏 Layout Optimizations
- Dialog height increased from `max-h-[90vh]` to `max-h-[95vh]` to use more screen space
- Removed nested scrolling containers that caused scroll-within-scroll UX issues
- Table max-height reduced from 320px to 192px to fit more content above the fold
- Action buttons now always remain visible without requiring scrolling

- [x] StatTile compact mode maintains visual consistency
